relationships.evidence_quote: we found that EA alleviates CCI-induced neuropathic pain by promoting miR-206-3p expression and inhibiting BDNF overexpression in the spinal dorsal horn

key_findings: EA raised spinal miR-206-3p and lowered BDNF, BAX/Bcl-2, IL-6 and TNF-alpha in CCI rats.
AAV miR-206-3p inhibitor partly abolished EA analgesia and raised BDNF and inflammatory markers.
